content: आहार्य {%<ab>pot. p.</ab>%} .²1 To be taken or seized. अनीहयागताहार्यनिर्वर्तितनिजक्रियः <ls>Bhāg. 10. 86. 14</ls>. .²2 To be fetched or brought near. .²3 To be extracted or removed. .²4 To be pervaded (व्याप्य). .²5 Artificial, adventitious, incidental, external, accessary; आहार्यशोभारहितैरमायैः <ls>Bk. 2. 14</ls>; न रम्यमाहार्यमपेक्षते गुणम् <ls>Ki. 4. 23</ls>; निसर्गसुभगस्य किमाहार्यकाडम्बरेन <ls>Malli.</ls> on <ls>Ku. 7. 20</ls>. .²6 Purposed, intended (as for instance, the identification or आरोप of उपमान or उपमेय in रूपक of which the speaker is fully cognisant); अयं चन्द्रो मुखमित्यादौ चन्द्रभिन्ने मुखे चन्द्राभेदज्ञानं तच्चाहार्यमेव <ls>Tv.</ls> .²7 Conveyed or effected by decoration or ornamentation, one of the 4 kinds of अभिनय <ab>q. v.</ab> .²8 To be eaten. .²9 To be worshipped (as Agni). .{@-र्यः@} A kind of bandage (बन्ध). .{@-र्यम्@} .²1 Any disease to be treated by means of extracting. .²2 Extraction. .²3 A vessel. .²4 The ornamentative part of the drama, such as dress, decorations <ab>&c.</ab> .{@-शोभा@} Adventitious beauty (not natural).
